profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | ex-Rockstar, ex-Snap, ex-AWS
profile.summary: I'm a generalist Software Engineer with an emphasis on web services and distributed systems. I enjoy solving seemingly impossible problems and take pride in my craftsmanship.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and built services for game features. Built client libraries for said services.
- Led major refactor and upgrade of legacy systems to improve testability, maintainability, and performance.
positions.insights: Skills: Game Development · C# · C++ · Web Services

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Shipped several indie games as a solo developer. Built physics systems, graphical effects, and 3d models from scratch. See portfolio at https://orchid-house.itch.io for more information.
positions.insights: Skills: Game Design · 3D Modeling · C++ · Unity · C#

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led vertical team of engineers to build services for Creators and Publishers to connect with and grow their fan base.
- Led sprint planning, technical design reviews, issue triaging, and mentoring.
- Built services using Golang and AWS for creating, editing, and serving Public Creator Profiles.
- Optimized backend for low cost and latency, handling several million profiles and tens of thousands of requests per second.
- Worked with Chat team to build a specialized fan mail inbox on top of the legacy chat system.
- Designed and built system for persisting video watch progress, optimized for fast reads.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer on team that built the Snap Map, a product for location sharing and map-based content consumption. Used by millions daily.
- Designed and built OpenGL-based render layer for displaying various map assets.
- Built system for real-time map data publishing and serving, designed to be consistent and fast.
- Collaborated with the Design team on rapid prototyping.

positions.title: SDE II
positions.description:
Software Engineer II on the Amazon Glacier team.

- Led team of three engineers to build fault tolerant throttling service, to help customers avoid accidental costs due to Glacier's complex billing system.
- Performed on-call and operational duties such as fixing existing defects, load testing, and introducing new service health metrics.

positions.title: SDE I
positions.description:
Software engineer on Kindle Ebook purchasing platform.

- Worked with peers to build broadcasting system for order processing events.
- Built distributed load testing tool, for finding scaling issues in preparation for traffic surges.
